prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent production hero illustration for ShuJian Cube, a refined light blue and white data creation studio.
Primary request: a sculptural isometric royal-blue data cube assembled from small porcelain document sheets and translucent rounded triangle data tiles flowing in a quiet arc. Convey raw documents becoming organized data, without words or diagrams.
Subject: one main layered cube with softly rounded edges, a few small white document slabs and translucent blue rounded-triangle tiles arranged around it in a graceful shallow arc. The composition should feel purposeful, distinctive, and exceptionally polished.
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D product render; restrained satin porcelain/clay and frosted glass; crisp silhouette and clean refined surfaces.
Composition/framing: landscape object cluster approximately 2.5:1, generous transparent padding on all sides, a compact cluster that remains clear when displayed around 360 by 150 pixels. Main cube has balanced layered depth, simple clear shapes, and minimal tiny details.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background. No room, no environment, no background plane, no card frame. Soft pale-blue grounding shadows only around the objects, preserving surrounding alpha.
Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting, elegant, quiet, airy, tasteful subtle specular highlights.
Color palette: royal blue #1769E0, light cyan, porcelain white, soft pale blue shadows, very small restrained teal accents.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no user interface. No hot neon, no busy particles, no oversized bulky scene, no dark background. Preserve real transparency.
